findings: The candidate preserves the distinctive tail-side grouping requirement instead of silently solving ordinary head-side k-group reversal.
It derives the n=qk+r equivalence: the unpaired remainder is exactly the head prefix of length r, so the remaining suffix can be processed left-to-right in ordinary k-blocks.
The ACM format is explicitly labeled as a chosen executable contract because the source does not preserve platform I/O syntax.
The exact Java program compiles, executes the declared sample, and matches an independent array-partition oracle on 6000 random cases plus remainder/divisible/n<k/k=1/empty/invalid-k boundaries.
